mechanism: Guanfacine may potentiate the hypotensive and CNS depressant effects of simvastatin, and both drugs can affect cardiovascular parameters; simvastatin is metabolized by CYP3A4 which guanfacine may modestly inhibit.
action: Monitor blood pressure and lipid panel regularly; consider alternative statin (pravastatin or rosuvastatin) if hypotension develops; counsel patient on additive CNS effects.
